name: Catimbau, Brazil: visitors
description: Oil-collecting Centris bees and the Malpighiaceae flowers they take floral oil from, in a dry caatinga park in Pernambuco, counted over a year from 2006. Visits run into the thousands.

citation.text: Elisangela L.S. Bezerra and Isabel C. Machado and Marco A. R. Mello (2009). Pollination networks of oil-flowers: a tiny world within the smallest of all worlds.
